searchText: I saw the portal network project. Seems interesting. Does anyone know what exactly the project around glados is ? Checkout its repository.. https://github.com/Ethereum/glados <@686695036733227017> I would like to explore more ideas related to compilers and virtual machines. Do you know any other team I should contact (apart from Ipsilon)? Depends on what you are interested in.. There are teams working on compilers for Solidity, Fe, Vyper, then there are zkevms and zk native VMs with their own langs but that would go outside of EPF scope. You can also checkout some EVM related EIPs and who worked on them because there are different people contributing towards it, not just Ipsilon, e.g. Uniswap labs.. But generally, you don't need to know what team does what, the goal now is to preperly research the topic and there can be various people who can help you during the project execution. Perfect, thanks! Office Hours recording from yesterday just dropped! If you missed it and you are interested in what are fellows going to work on, check it out. https://drive.google.com/file/d/1A5qAofBdn-N3KcoFDNSE3AFa7e-wIB2Q i really liked these particular diagrams on CL/EL interactions with block building and block validation. Wanted to share it: https://hackmd.io/@n0ble/HkoYcDDt5 There was no sound coming from Mario's end when he was talking during this recording. Did anyone experience this? The software that Mario uses to record the calls sometimes does that for the recordings. 😬 Ah, alright Hi <@486477492434239488> I am approaching Reth, currently running it on my computer (with lighthouse as CL) and starting to experiment with it. In the suggested projects for this EPF cohort Reth is not mentioned but I was wondering if there are some possible issues or features I could work on? Thanks I muted my mic for the recording because I was in public place and wanted to make sure the sound is clean. I didn't talk much anyway so I just kept it tuned down, I believe nothing important is missing https://github.com/paradigmxyz/reth/issues?q=is%3Aopen+is%3Aissue+label%3AD-good-first-issue Thank you for the link🙏. Yes I am already looking to first issues. I was wondering if it is a project I could consider for a EPF project. Becoming a regular reth contributor is a fantastic EPF project as you work on easy issues you'll gain confidence + context that will allow you to tackle bigger projects in reth Thank you very much. Appreciate your feedback good luck

excerpts.author: tmiychao
excerpts.content:
Depends on what you are interested in.. There are teams working on compilers for Solidity, Fe, Vyper, then there are zkevms and zk native VMs with their own langs but that would go outside of EPF scope. You can also checkout some EVM related EIPs and who worked on them because there are different people contributing towards it, not just Ipsilon, e.g. Uniswap labs..

But generally, you don't need to know what team does what, the goal now is to preperly research the topic and there can be various people who can help you during the project execution.
